test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He lost his mother when he was seven and his father when he was thirteen, ______which the orphan boy was sent off by guardian uncles to a grammar school at Hawkshead.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The filling word is expected to indicate an event occurred after which another event happened. The only choice indicating this sequence is **"upon".**
 
• **"Upon"** is often used to denote something happening as a result of something else, which fits the context of the sentence.
 
• So, the completed sentence should read: "He lost his mother when he was seven and his father when he was thirteen, upon which the orphan boy was sent off by guardian uncles to a grammar school at Hawkshead."

Therefore, the correct answer is - **Option 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **"Before"** suggests an event occuring prior to another,** "on"** indicates a **specific time or date**, and **"against"** typically means in opposition to something. None of these meanings fit the given sentence.
 
• **"Upon"** can also mean** "on"**, but it is often used in more formal contexts or in curated phrases.
